rule.title: A net capital loss reaches line 7a only up to ($3,000), or ($1,500) if married filing separately

citation.wording: If line 16 is a loss, enter here and on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 7a, the smaller of: • The loss on line 16; or • ($3,000), or if married filing separately, ($1,500)

rule.open_point: Applied to the 1040 line 7a total, which is every capital figure the sheet places (Schedule D line 16's net). A gain is untouched. The disallowed part is not lost: it is the capital loss carryover the software works (computations short-term-capital-loss-carryover / long-term-capital-loss-carryover), never figured here.
